name: New York City
tagline: Loud, fast, and somehow exactly right.
journal:
New York doesn't owe you anything and it's better that way. I walked from the Lower East Side up to Midtown one Saturday — six hours, no plan, three slices of pizza.

A jazz trio in Washington Square. The 6 train delayed for reasons no one explained. A bookstore that smelled like every bookstore I've ever loved.

I went up to a rooftop at golden hour. The city looked tired and gorgeous and somehow younger than it has any right to be.
